hypothesis: Investors may overweight realized return states that stand out against same-day market alternatives; a salience-weighted expectation above the ordinary historical mean may imply overvaluation and lower subsequent returns. Weak negative prior only.
mechanism: Context-dependent probability reweighting, not a new price source or a proven short-horizon alpha. Cosemans/Frehen2021 motivates monthly US salience; rolling20TD strict-endpoint fixed2115 and1/5day outcomes are local unvalidated choices.
expected_direction: higher_is_better=false; weak negative prior fixed before candidate outcomes
falsifiable: Fixed G1-G7 plus specified neighbors; reject if direction/stability/incremental information fails; no parameter search, sign reversal, control removal, or changing window/minimum sample.
fields: current and previous exchange-day universe eligibility
origin: Lead-approved unique R7 E salience proposal; no returns inspected

literature.title: Salience theory and stock prices: Empirical evidence
literature.scope_boundary: US monthly evidence is mechanism source, not local1/5day performance evidence
